## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/selfcheck.sh` is green
- [ ] `bash scripts/sync.sh` run — `.claude/skills/` mirror is in sync (if I touched `skills/`)
- [ ] If I added/changed a hook: fixture added/updated in `scripts/selfcheck.sh`, and wired in **both** `hooks/hooks.json` and `.claude/settings.json`
- [ ] If I added a skill/agent/hook: updated the counts and tables in `README.md` + `CLAUDE.md`
- [ ] No personal names, client names, or business-specific data (kept it neutral)
- [ ] No new dependencies (or justified above)
